metaTitle: Custom LED Light Drawstring Backpacks | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom LED light drawstring backpacks for events or safety gear. Ideal for promotions. Call us for bulk pricing.
introHtml: Custom LED light drawstring backpacks combine the convenience of a lightweight carry-all with built-in illumination for visibility and safety. Ideal for evening runs, outdoor events, or as safety giveaways for night-shift workers, these bags feature bright LED strips that make wearers stand out in low light. Decorate the front panel with your logo using screen printing or embroidery for a functional promotional item that keeps your brand visible after dark.
heroAltText: Custom LED light drawstring backpack with bright LED strips on the front, perfect for nighttime visibility and promotions.
